stemMarkdown: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. If one of the interior angles on the same side of the transversal is $35$ degrees, find the other one (in degrees).
solutionMarkdown: Co-interior (allied) angles between parallel lines are supplementary, so the other angle is $180 - 35 = 145$ degrees.
altSolutionMarkdown: Corresponding and alternate angles are equal; only co-interior angles add to 180.
